source: Four user photographs of Português a Valer 3 glossary: de tutela pública–desgastante, ciclone–consultório, aproximar–base, à medida que–ajustar; printed page numbers not visible
normalization_notes: Assistant visual transcription of the Portuguese and English glossary columns. Other languages and internal lesson-page reference columns are not transcribed.
Printed page numbers are outside the photographs. Keep page=null and stable image identifiers; no page numbers are inferred.
Original phrases, article annotations, capitalization and source English are retained. Individual vocabulary is lowercased and NFC normalized.
Split expressions and reflexive clitics into separately translated words. Retain lexical compound meia-idade; preserve inflected forms as printed rather than silently lemmatizing.
Gender-neutral headwords such as argumentista and assaltante produce one spelling each; gender article alternatives are metadata, not additional words.

Ukrainian translations, per-word CEFR estimates, topic assignments, English component translations and corrections are assistant supplied and not independently reviewed. B1 book level is user-supplied metadata.
Topics use existing thematic and grammatical labels. Provenance remains metadata. No database connection, conflict comparison or import is performed.
Each photo has a separate extracted JSON; original photos and combined extracted/enriched batches are retained.
extraction_method: Assistant visual transcription of supplied photographs

rows.english_original: to put a lot of effort into
to put on the back burner

rows.enrichment_note: Printed descendent retained; descendant is the usual English noun spelling.
Printed to open is broad; desem(b)alar specifically means to unpack/unwrap.
Printed to make is contextual; conferir a normally means to confer/grant to. Translate the verb and preposition separately.
Printed to come (from) is misleading for constar de; preserve source and clarify meaning.
Portuguese is an adjective, not an infinitive; not the English false friend constipated.
Printed storage is retained; clarify common European Portuguese noun senses.
Printed automation is broader; the usual Portuguese term for automation is automatização.
Printed initiative is contextual; autonomy/independence is the standalone meaning.
Portuguese is an adjective; printed beach is a noun.
